DISPOSITION.read_the_ev_column_this_way: The large positive EVs sit on heavy underdogs, and that is exactly where this arm is weakest rather than where an opportunity is. STANDINGS_LOG5_v1 sees only season win-loss records: no injuries, no rest, no lineup. Tonight A'ja Wilson is questionable, Brionna Jones is out, Toronto has five players listed, and no 8/28-dated report exists for Washington or Los Angeles at all. A model blind to all of that, disagreeing with a market that prices it, is describing its own blindness. Treat these as a calibration diagnostic on the fallback arm, not as edges.
DISPOSITION.why_no_selection_is_a_fact_not_a_judgeme: Both arms that survive this morning's block are non-selecting by construction. STANDINGS_LOG5_v1 is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_ACTION_BLOCKED in its own registration. EXPANDING_HOME_PRIOR is a registered constant with no game-specific information. The one arm that could have carried a real view, FEATURE_REFRESH, is blocked on the feature rebuild. There is therefore no arm on this board that is permitted to select, whatever the EV column says.
